Marina (Partnerships): FYI - AcmeEdge asked if we can surface per-seat overrides in the marketplace usage webhook. They want seat_changes (add/remove) included in the hourly usage so downstream billing can prorate mid-cycle. Risk: double-billing if reconciliation isn't clear. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): Do we accept seat_count or seat_delta in partner payloads today? IIRC marketplace events carry usage_units and sku_id only.

Nina (Billing): Ledger ingestion currently expects a stable entitlement per billing epoch. Mid-cycle seat adjustments are handled by a separate adjustments feed, not the usage stream. If partners mix them we risk breaking idempotency unless webhook includes a deterministic entitlement_sequence. :exclamation:

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge prefers a single webhook and proposed adding seat_delta and seat_snapshot to the same event. They can provide an idempotency_key per change.

Sam (Integrations Eng): If we accept seat_snapshot we can use it as the source of truth for entitlement reconciliation. Need to define semantics: is snapshot absolute seat_count at event_ts? Do we accept negative seat_delta? Also confirm usage_units semantics remain unchanged.

Nina (Billing): Proposal: require seat_snapshot (absolute integer) and entitlement_sequence (monotonic integer per customer). If a lower sequence arrives, ignore it. Store last_applied_sequence per customer so we remain idempotent and can compute prorate deltas.

Alex (SRE): Works storage-wise but watch out for retries + out-of-order delivery. We already dedupe on event_id; adding entitlement_sequence helps. Also add a replay endpoint for partners to backfill missed seat changes and a runbook for using it.

Marina (Partnerships): AcmeEdge also asked about tax/currency rounding when prorating mid-month. They want invoice lines to reflect exact cents per seat change. Can billing do cents-level prorate adjustments?

Nina (Billing): We can emit adjustment line items in minor units (cents). Prorate = (days_remaining / days_in_cycle) * monthly_price_per_seat. Rounding policy: banker's rounding. Need to decide whether to credit current invoice or next invoice. Ops prefers adjustment on current open invoice if within invoice_window, else queue for next invoice and mark as pending credit.

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge wants credits applied immediately. They'll accept initial behavior: adjustment on current invoice if invoice_status=open, otherwise queue to next invoice and notify customer.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Draft webhook v2 payload suggestion:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt-01F5...",
  "event_ts": "2026-03-20T12:34:56Z",
  "customer_id": "cust-123",
  "sku_id": "acme-seats-monthly",
  "usage_units": 1200,
  "seat_snapshot": 42,
  "entitlement_sequence": 17,
  "idempotency_key": "replay-20260320-17"
}
```
Keep usage_units for metering and seat_snapshot for entitlement reconciliation. We'll ack with entitlement_applied + last_applied_sequence on success.

Alex (SRE): Add rate limits for seat change path to prevent spikes during bulk seat migrations. Enforce payload size limits and surface metric "partner.entitlement.sequence.skew" to detect missing sequences.

Nina (Billing): Action items for billing: (1) add entitlement_sequence handling in ledger writer and compute prorate adjustments, (2) implement rounding policy (banker's rounding in cents), (3) define invoice-window cutoff logic. I'll draft an RFC this week and tag Legal for refunds/credits language.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Action items for integrations: (1) publish webhook schema v2 with seat_snapshot + entitlement_sequence + idempotency_key, (2) implement ack endpoint, (3) add replay endpoint + partner test harness. I'll open PRs and a staging test.

Jordan (Partner Success): I'll coordinate with AcmeEdge PM to confirm they can emit entitlement_sequence and run replays if needed. I'll share sample payloads and replay plan.

Alex (SRE): I'll add dashboard tiles for sequence skew and processing latency and write a mini-runbook for out-of-order entitlements.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-3421 for "Entitlement sequence + prorate support" and linked here. :white_check_mark:

Marina (Partnerships): Great. Target: partner beta by end of next sprint for AcmeEdge joint announcement. I'll hold weekly sync until schema v2 is stable. :thumbsup:
